summary: Frontend-only verification of DynoPay v8 SEO landing redesign (Phase 3) across all 21 /for/* vertical pages, 2 /compare/* pages, plus footer-v8 and regression on home + product pages. Every acceptance criterion in the review request passes end-to-end against the live preview URL. All 23 SEO pages render seo-hero (with seo-breadcrumbs, gold-tail seo-hero-title, seo-hero-cta pointing to /auth/register?src=seo&page=<slug>&kind=<vertical|comparison>, seo-hero-fees -> /fees) and the correct hero mock via [data-testid=seo-hero-illustration][data-mock]: /for/ecommerce,dropshipping,gaming,hosting,vpn,marketplaces,merchants,digital-downloads,online-courses,forex-trading => checkout; freelancers/agencies/consultants => invoice; nonprofits/fundraisers/web3-daos => donation; creators => creator; affiliate-marketing/remittance => payout; developers/saas => api; coingate+coinpayments => compare. The ecommerce checkout mock renders 'Pay Northwind Studio' / $148.00 / Tron / USDT / INV-2026-0412 / TCq3…9vXk and the compare mock renders 'SWITCHING FROM COINGATE' with the 6 rows (Custody, Settlement, Auto-convert, Chargebacks, Fees, First payment). Downstream sections all mount with their testids: stat-band (count-ups 1,076 / 79+ / 40+ / 99.92%), seo-intro, seo-features (3 for verticals, 4 for /compare/* => 2x2 grid), seo-how-it-works dark panel with 3 seo-step-N cards, seo-faq with 5 seo-faq-N items (click expands seo-faq-answer-N), seo-related-pages with 3 seo-related-link-* cards, seo-final-cta with primary=/auth/register?src=seo&... and secondary=/pay/demo, and site-footer. SEO head preserved on /for/ecommerce: canonical https://dynopay.com/for/ecommerce, 7 hreflang alternates (en,pt,fr,es,de,nl,x-default), and 4 ld+json scripts of types WebPage, FAQPage, BreadcrumbList, SoftwareApplication. i18n verified: /for/saas?lang=pt translates h1 ('Aceite pagamentos em criptomoeda para produtos SaaS e de subscrição sem chargebacks'), stat-band ('PAGAMENTOS LIQUIDADOS ESTE MÊS'), step label ('PASSO 1'), and final-cta badge ('No ar em minutos · sem cartão de crédito'); /for/ecommerce?lang=de translates h1, sections, stat-band and 'SCHRITT 1/2/3' step labels (verified visually - innerText comes back uppercased, which is why case-sensitive 'Schritt' substring returned False but 'has_german' + screenshot confirm). Footer-v8 (data-testid site-footer) renders near-black rgb(11, 11, 10) in BOTH light and dark theme (unchanged after header theme toggle), with footer-logo, footer-status-link -> /system-status, 30 footer-link-* items across 5 columns, footer-wordmark, footer-trust-row, footer-copyright, and footer-language-globe; clicking the globe opens footer-language-panel and clicking footer-lang-pt updates the URL to ?lang=pt and the H1 to Portuguese. Responsive at 390x844: document.documentElement.scrollWidth == 390 on /for/ecommerce, /for/saas, /compare/coingate, /, /products/payment-links, /products/checkout, /fees, /products, /about, /trust — no horizontal page overflow anywhere; site-footer present on all. Regression: homepage and the two shared product pages (payment-links, checkout) still render with no console errors. Zero pageerror or console-error events were captured across every page navigated (24+ pages).
critical_code_review_comments: SEOHeroMock.tsx slug->mock map is verified correct for all 21 verticals + 2 compares; no missing mapping fallback was triggered.

SEOLandingPage head block correctly emits exactly 4 ld+json scripts (WebPage/FAQPage/BreadcrumbList/SoftwareApplication) and 7 hreflang alternates (en,pt,fr,es,de,nl,x-default) with canonical bound to https://dynopay.com/for/<slug>.

HomeFooter v8 panel background computes to rgb(11,11,10) in both themes - matches 'always-dark near-black' requirement; MockPanelV8 and CheckoutCard dynamic coin/network icon swap works for the Tron/USDT ecommerce example.

Minor nit (not blocking): the + icon rotation on seo-faq-N could not be programmatically asserted with a generic svg selector; functionally the toggle works (seo-faq-answer-N visibility flips). If main agent wants automated regression on the rotation, add data-testid='seo-faq-icon-N' to the plus/minus element.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 3 v8 SEO redesign is production-ready. Verified on https://secure-vault-app-57.preview.emergentagent.com. When writing Playwright for i18n assertions, note that step labels & stat-band labels render via CSS text-transform:uppercase, so document.body.innerText returns 'PASSO'/'SCHRITT' (uppercased) not 'Passo'/'Schritt' - use case-insensitive matches. Preview env has a Cloudflare 429 rate limit so inter-page sleeps of ~2.5-2.8s were used; keep that pattern. Footer-v8 is intentionally the same near-black panel in both themes - do NOT flag that as a theme bug.
rca of the issue: No defects found. Review request fully satisfied.
